Struct LoggerSettings

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Logging
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents the configuration settings for the Logger. Controls logging enablement, minimum log level, output type, and log file path.

public LoggerSettings(LogLevel minimumLevel)

Parameters

minimumLevel LogLevel

The minimum log level required for messages to be logged. Messages below this level will be ignored.

LoggerSettings(LogLevel, string, bool)

Initializes a new instance of the LoggerSettings struct with a specified minimum log level, log file path, and an option to also log to the console.

public LoggerSettings(LogLevel minimumLevel, string logFilePath, bool logToConsole = false)

Parameters

minimumLevel LogLevel

The minimum log level required for messages to be logged.

logFilePath string

The file path to write log messages to.

logToConsole bool

If true, log messages will be written to both the console and the log file.

Remarks

If the logFilePath is not valid the LogOutputType will be set to Console and the LogFilePath will be empty. If the specified log file already exists it will be cleared before starting logging.
